BorderSwitch.description:
Gränsväxel (grindväxel): a switch at the border between a part's area and the station's.

Its owner lays it both ways. The other side may always lay it towards the part's area, where
it keeps the two apart, and never out (TKL99, RANG-12); Klart and Grindar lay it back there.
A route out over it is a request that the station's interlocking sets.

switch.description: Växelns nummer, eller en korsningsväxels del.
switch.title: Switch

towards_part.description: Läget mot delens område, som skiljer delen från stationen: dit får den som inte äger växeln alltid lägga den, aldrig ut.

BorderSwitch.title: BorderSwitch

confirmed.description: Ägaren har bekräftat uppgiften. Antaget syns gult i Studio.
confirmed.title: Confirmed

ref.description: Uppgiftens namn i källan, till exempel AnyRail-id 1680 eller Vx162.
ref.title: Ref

Origin.title: Origin

PartRules.description:
The rules at the border, set per station in Studio (TKL99). The defaults are those of
the first station divided into parts (TKL99): the station steers the border switches, the
part may lay them towards its area and never out, and an approved request can only be
returned.

lays_towards_part.description: Delen får lägga stationens gränsväxlar mot sitt område, aldrig ut (RANG-12). Annars lägger bara stationen dem.
lays_towards_part.title: Lays Towards Part

one_way.description: Envägsregeln (RANG-09): en godkänd begäran kan delen bara lämna tillbaka, aldrig lägga själv, och stationen tar inte tillbaka den medan den är delens.
one_way.title: One Way

PartRules.title: PartRules

PartSide.description: Ände: the end of the part a switch street or a route out belongs to (TKL109, TKL122).
PartSide.title: PartSide

Position.description: A switch's two positions. + is straight (rakt), - is diverging (avvikande).
Position.title: Position

RouteOut.description:
Begärd väg (RANG-03): a station route out over the border that the part may request.
The station's interlocking sets it when the request is approved; until the part returns it
the route is the part's (envägsregeln).

track.description: Stationens spår vägen leder till, till exempel 3.

start.title: Start

StationPart.description:
Delställverk (TKL97–TKL103): a fixed area of the station with its own operator, against
the station's one interlocking, which locks every route.

Its area is the same kind of area as local release's (TKL103): track circuits or pieces,
the switches the part lays freely and the signals in it. Its border is the border switches,
with their owner, and the signals at the border. The part may be its own driftplats in
Hubben (TKL101). Its switch streets and the routes out it may request belong to it.

own_place.description: En egen driftplats i Hubben, som bemannas för sig (TKL101). Annars syns delen inte i Hubben.
own_place.title: Own Place

code.description: Driftplatsens signatur i Hubben, när delen är en egen driftplats (TKL101). Tomt: namnet används.
code.title: Code

routes_out.description: Vägarna ut över gränsen som delen får begära.

SwitchStreet.description:
Växelgata (RANG-02): the part's switches laid straight out to a track with one press,
without a route, a lock or a signal, as in old TKL. A switch in it that lies in a locked
route refuses the whole street.

name.title: Name

track.description: Spåret gatan leder till, till exempel 51 eller Lastspår 1.
track.title: Track

positions.description: Växlarna i gatan, med sina lägen.
